command:
set -eu
CA_DIR=/root/os-comparison-root-ca
CA_KEY="$CA_DIR/os-comparison-root-ca.key.pem"
CA_CERT="$CA_DIR/os-comparison-root-ca.crt.pem"
CA_PASS="$CA_DIR/.key-passphrase"
umask 077
install -d -m 700 -o root -g root "$CA_DIR"
if [ -e "$CA_KEY" ] || [ -e "$CA_CERT" ] || [ -e "$CA_PASS" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' 'Refusing to overwrite existing CA material' >&2
  exit 1
fi
openssl rand -base64 48 > "$CA_PASS"
chmod 600 "$CA_PASS"
openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:3072 -aes-256-cbc -pass file:"$CA_PASS" -out "$CA_KEY" 2>/dev/null
chmod 600 "$CA_KEY"
openssl req -x509 -new -sha256 -days 3650 -key "$CA_KEY" -passin file:"$CA_PASS" -out "$CA_CERT" -subj '/CN=OS Comparison Root CA' -addext 'basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE,pathlen:0' -addext 'keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign' -addext 'subjectKeyIdentifier=hash' -addext 'authorityKeyIdentifier=keyid:always'
chmod 644 "$CA_CERT"
restorecon -RF "$CA_DIR" 2>/dev/null || true
openssl x509 -in "$CA_CERT" -noout -subject -issuer -serial -fingerprint -sha256 -dates
openssl x509 -in "$CA_CERT" -noout -text | grep -A3 -E 'X509v3 Basic Constraints|X509v3 Key Usage|X509v3 Subject Key Identifier|X509v3 Authority Key Identifier'
printf '%s\n' '== key/certificate validation =='
openssl pkey -in "$CA_KEY" -passin file:"$CA_PASS" -check -noout
CERT_PUB=$(openssl x509 -in "$CA_CERT" -pubkey -noout | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)
KEY_PUB=$(openssl pkey -in "$CA_KEY" -passin file:"$CA_PASS" -pubout | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)
[ "$CERT_PUB" = "$KEY_PUB" ]
printf '%s\n' 'certificate and private key match'
stat -c '%n %a %U:%G %s' "$CA_DIR" "$CA_KEY" "$CA_CERT" "$CA_PASS"
printf '%s\n' '== pre-install default trust check (expected rejection) =='
if openssl verify "$CA_CERT"; then
  printf '%s\n' 'unexpectedly trusted before installation' >&2
  exit 1
else
  printf '%s\n' 'confirmed not trusted before installation'
fi

  if ss -lnt | grep -Fq "$NODE_IP:19443"; then break; fi
  i=$((i + 1))
  sleep 1
done
printf '%s\n' '== post-restart TLS trust via managed node IP =='
openssl s_client -connect "$NODE_IP:19443" -verify_ip "$NODE_IP" -verify_return_error </dev/null 2>&1 | grep -E '^(depth=|Verification:|Verify return code:|CONNECTED)'
curl --noproxy '*' --fail --silent --show-error --connect-timeout 5 --output /dev/null --write-out 'curl_http=%{http_code} curl_cert_verify=%{ssl_verify_result}\n' "https://$NODE_IP:19443/"
cleanup
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
[ ! -e "$TEST_DIR" ]
if ss -lnt | grep -Fq "$NODE_IP:19443"; then exit 1; fi
printf '%s\n' 'post-restart TLS validation succeeded; temporary material and listener removed'

set -eu
CA_DIR=/root/os-comparison-root-ca
TEST_DIR=$(mktemp -d /tmp/os-ca-tls-test.XXXXXX)
SERVER_PID=
cleanup() {
  if [ -n "$SERVER_PID" ]; then kill "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
  rm -rf "$TEST_DIR"
}
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
umask 077
openssl req -new -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -keyout "$TEST_DIR/server.key" -out "$TEST_DIR/server.csr" -subj '/CN=node1' 2>/dev/null
printf '%s\n' 'basicConstraints=critical,CA:FALSE' 'keyUsage=critical,digitalSignature,keyEncipherment' 'extendedKeyUsage=serverAuth' "subjectAltName=DNS:node1,IP:$NODE_IP" > "$TEST_DIR/server.ext"
SERIAL=$(openssl rand -hex 16)
openssl x509 -req -in "$TEST_DIR/server.csr" -CA "$CA_DIR/os-comparison-root-ca.crt.pem" -CAkey "$CA_DIR/os-comparison-root-ca.key.pem" -passin file:"$CA_DIR/.key-passphrase" -set_serial "0x$SERIAL" -days 1 -sha256 -extfile "$TEST_DIR/server.ext" -out "$TEST_DIR/server.crt" 2>/dev/null
openssl s_server -quiet -www -accept "$NODE_IP:19443" -cert "$TEST_DIR/server.crt" -key "$TEST_DIR/server.key" > "$TEST_DIR/server.log" 2>&1 &
SERVER_PID=$!
i=0
while [ "$i" -lt 20 ]; do
  if ss -lnt | grep -Fq "$NODE_IP:19443"; then break; fi
  i=$((i + 1))
  sleep 1
done
printf '%s\n' '== post-restart TLS trust via managed node IP =='
openssl s_client -connect "$NODE_IP:19443" -verify_ip "$NODE_IP" -verify_return_error </dev/null 2>&1 | grep -E '^(depth=|Verification:|Verify return code:|CONNECTED)'
curl --noproxy '*' --fail --silent --show-error --connect-timeout 5 --output /dev/null --write-out 'curl_http=%{http_code} curl_cert_verify=%{ssl_verify_result}\n' "https://$NODE_IP:19443/"
cleanup
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
[ ! -e "$TEST_DIR" ]
if ss -lnt | grep -Fq "$NODE_IP:19443"; then exit 1; fi
printf '%s\n' 'post-restart TLS validation succeeded; temporary material and listener removed'
